artifact_review: The Router identified blur (severity 3) and text gibberish (severity 2). The mask from the Topology Auditor shows a clean rectangular shape, confirming the device geometry is intact, but doesn't rule out the internal texture issues. I maintain that the text gibberish is a significant artifact for this class.

The form factor is correct (rectangular slab, screen dominant), but the lack of visible physical keys (obscured by shadow/blur) and the generic nature of the device push it away from the specific 'hand-held computer' taxonomy which often implies distinct input methods. The screen UI is structurally plausible but semantically broken (gibberish text).
